main_measure.name: mean of (forecast/10) x (5-bar forward return minus coin's mean 5-bar return), forecast<0, non-overlapping grid

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day summed as one piece of evidence

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passed; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-bar return, deepest third minus shallowest third (must be < 0)

decided_by: t of the mean product lies between -2 and 2
reading: the rising calm profile is the recorded regime 'unknown'; grid cells need a full 5-bar forward return inside the window; the coin's mean is over all its grid returns in all windows; thirds are n//3 cases at each end sorted by forecast; the t uses a day-clustered standard error.
